title: Guidance Note: Documents and Decisions on Hardship Requests (Hardship Assistance Programs)
content:
A request under the Hardship Assistance Programs is decided only on the documents the program requires, as recorded document lines on the plan; a borrower's description of a document is never a substitute for the recorded document.

## Receiving documents

Documents may be received while the request is requested or offered, or while the plan is active. Each document received is recorded on the plan by its kind and the day it was received.

## Timing of the decision

The decision is made within the program's decision business days once every required document is on file. A program that requires no documents is decided on the records alone.

## The document period

A request missing required documents is declined for "documents not received" only when the current date is later than the request date plus the program's document due days. The document period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the request date, and a document received on the last day of the period is in time.

| Request date | Document due days | Last day of the period | Earliest day a decline for missing documents is possible |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 May (hypothetical) | 14 | 15 May | 16 May |
| 1 May (hypothetical) | 21 | 22 May | 23 May |

A document recorded on 15 May in the first row is in time; on 15 May the request is not yet declinable for missing documents.

## Outcome

A request that meets the program and limit rules is offered (or applied directly when the program needs no acceptance); otherwise it is declined with the first applicable reason in this order:

1. loan status ineligible
2. no qualifying hardship
3. not eligible for the program
4. relief limit reached
5. documents not received

*Hypothetical:* a request whose loan status fits but whose hardship reason is not a qualifying reason, and whose documents are also missing past the period, is declined for "no qualifying hardship", the earlier reason in the order.

The required documents, the document due days and the decision business days of each program are those of the program's documents and decision timetable.
